enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.hint: Off leaves the sidebar exactly as Foundry has it (no Mysteries button) and collects nothing; the Clue type, the Clues and the parties' records stay.

sheetFields.foundAtHint: In the DM's words: where the party found it (optional)
sheetFields.notInWorld: Import this Clue into the world to collect it: drag it onto the party, or onto Mysteries.

collect.removed: {name} was taken out of {group}'s Mysteries. The Clue is still in the Items directory.
collect.gmOnly: Only a GM collects a Clue.
collect.noParty: No party yet. Mysteries keeps a record for each dnd5e Group actor; make one and collect into it.
collect.neverCarried: A Clue is never carried: it goes to the party's Mysteries. Drop it on the party, on a member, or on Mysteries.
collect.failed: Mysteries could not collect the Clue ({reason}).

mysteries.title: Mysteries
mysteries.empty: Nothing collected yet. When the DM collects a Clue it appears here.
mysteries.noParty: No party yet. Mysteries keeps a record for each dnd5e Group actor.
mysteries.allCollected: every Clue in the world is collected
mysteries.dropHint: or drop a Clue anywhere on this window

read.notePrompt: A note on {name}, in your words, for the whole party to see.
read.noReader: You have no character in this party, so the read is not marked.
read.notOwner: You do not own {group}, so the read is not marked in its Mysteries.
read.pickReaderHint: You own more than one member of the party. The read is marked for the one you pick.
read.failed: Mysteries could not mark the read ({reason}).
read.revision: Revision {n}: the Clue changed since it was collected; this is the text as it reads now.
read.itemGone: The Clue is gone from the world; the entry keeps what was collected.
read.entryGone: That entry is no longer in Mysteries.
